title: Mastering CSS 'text-align' & 'text-align-last' for Refined Web Typography and UI Readability
tweet: Elevate your #WebTypography & #UIDesign! Dive deep into CSS 'text-align' and 'text-align-last' to create balanced, readable text blocks. Improve user experience with perfect justification. #CSS #WebFonts
tip: Beyond basic 'text-align: justify', leverage 'text-align-last' to precisely control the final line's alignment in a justified text block. Setting it to 'start' or 'center' prevents awkward single words from stretching, significantly enhancing visual balance and #WebFonts readability in your #UIDesign for a superior #UserExperience.
